verdict.rationale: Postman's docs explicitly say its API client sends HTTP, GraphQL, and gRPC requests, and they mention 'multi-protocol requests' in the lightweight client. However, WebSocket and SSE are never named, so only about half of the listed protocols are evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of WebSocket request support, explicit documentation of SSE support, independent or hands-on corroboration of non-REST protocol use.
